title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
The tanker market remains in the spotlight, now with Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline shutdown amplifying theimpact of the disruption of the Strait of Hormuz even more. Wednesday's developments suggested that a restart of the pipeline is likely, with around half of its total 7 mb/d capacity expected to be restored in the near term, while a full return to operations is considered realistic by October. At the same time, shuttling / STS operations that free up trapped cargo which is loaded at the Gulf of Oman continue to be preferred by shipowners over performing a crossing of the Strait.
